name: devbar
description: Dev status line for Claude Code: project, git, last test, CI, the project's own ports and a context/usage meter

showLastCheck.title: Show last test
showLastCheck.description: Result of the last test, build or typecheck Claude ran

showCi.title: Show CI
showCi.description: GitHub Actions result for the current branch (needs gh)

showPr.title: Show pull request
showPr.description: Open PR of the current branch and its review state (needs gh)

showPorts.title: Show ports
showPorts.description: Ports of servers started from this project, and its Docker Compose services

plainBranch.title: Plain branch button
plainBranch.description: Branch button (opens the git panel) without [ ] brackets

plainPorts.title: Plain port buttons
plainPorts.description: Port buttons (copy the localhost URL) without [ ] brackets

plainCi.title: Plain CI button
plainCi.description: CI button (copies the run link) without [ ] brackets

plainPr.title: Plain PR button
plainPr.description: PR button (copies the PR link) without [ ] brackets

plainFix.title: Plain fix buttons
plainFix.description: Fix buttons of a failed test or CI without [ ] brackets

plainMeter.title: Plain meter button
plainMeter.description: Meter button (Context / 5 hours / Week / Cost) without [ ] brackets

plainCompact.title: Plain compact button
plainCompact.description: The 'compact' word after the tokens left (fills /compact) without [ ] brackets

plainPaneActions.title: Plain commit/review buttons
plainPaneActions.description: Commit and review buttons of the git panel without [ ] brackets

plainHashes.title: Plain commit hashes
plainHashes.description: Commit hash buttons of the git panel without [ ] brackets

plainEffort.title: Plain effort button
plainEffort.description: Effort button next to the model (fills /effort) without [ ] brackets

plainProject.title: Plain folder button
plainProject.description: Project folder button (copies its full path) without [ ] brackets

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long Claude Code keeps the prompt cache warm on your account (1h on most subscriptions, 5m on API keys)

commitPrompt.title: Commit prompt
commitPrompt.description: Text the git panel's commit button puts in the prompt. Empty uses the built-in text

reviewPrompt.title: Review prompt
reviewPrompt.description: Text the git panel's review button puts in the prompt. Empty uses /code-review high

testFixPrompt.title: Test fix prompt
testFixPrompt.description: Text the fix button of a failed test puts in the prompt; {command} becomes the command that failed. Empty uses the built-in text

ciFixPrompt.title: CI fix prompt
ciFixPrompt.description: Text the fix button of a failed CI puts in the prompt. Empty uses the built-in text

compactPrompt.title: Compact prompt
compactPrompt.description: Text the compact button next to the context meter puts in the prompt. Empty uses /compact

modelPrompt.title: Model prompt
modelPrompt.description: Text the model button puts in the prompt. Empty uses /model

effortPrompt.title: Effort prompt
effortPrompt.description: Text the effort button next to the model puts in the prompt. Empty uses /effort

worktreeEnterPrompt.title: Worktree enter prompt
worktreeEnterPrompt.description: Text the git panel's enter button of a worktree puts in the prompt; {path} becomes its path relative to the session (absolute on another drive or a network share) and {worktree} its name (empty when the name is not a single word). With a custom text, paths with spaces get no button. Empty uses /cd {path}

worktreeRemovePrompt.title: Worktree remove prompt
worktreeRemovePrompt.description: Text the git panel's remove button of a worktree puts in the prompt; {worktree} becomes its name. Empty uses the built-in text

worktreePrunePrompt.title: Worktree prune prompt
worktreePrunePrompt.description: Text the git panel's prune stale button puts in the prompt. Empty uses the built-in text
